text: Area residents have presented a petition requesting the installation of speed humps on Glebeholme Boulevard between Greenwood and Coxwell Avenues. Residents representing about 70% of the households on the street signed the petition to address concerns regarding vehicle speeds and road safety.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District, to investigate the feasibility of traffic calming measures on Glebeholme Boulevard, between Greenwood Avenue and Coxwell Avenue, in the form of speed humps.
